### type AuditNotification

```go
type AuditNotification struct {
	SourceTimestamp *TimeStamp
	TargetTimestamp *TimeStamp
	SourceDevice    AuditRecipient
	SourceObject    *bacnet.ObjectIdentifier
	Operation       uint32 // BACnetAuditOperation
	SourceComment   *string
	TargetComment   *string
	InvokeID        *uint8
	SourceUserID    *uint16
	SourceUserRole  *uint8
	TargetDevice    AuditRecipient
	TargetObject    *bacnet.ObjectIdentifier
	TargetProperty  *bacnet.PropertyReference
	TargetPriority  *uint8
	// TargetValue and CurrentValue hold a single application value, or a
	// ValueConstructed value with the elements of anything else.
	TargetValue  *bacnet.ApplicationValue
	CurrentValue *bacnet.ApplicationValue
	Result       *AuditResult
}
```

AuditNotification is a BACnetAuditNotification (Clause 21):

	source-timestamp [0] BACnetTimeStamp OPTIONAL
	target-timestamp [1] BACnetTimeStamp OPTIONAL
	source-device    [2] BACnetRecipient
	source-object    [3] BACnetObjectIdentifier OPTIONAL
	operation        [4] BACnetAuditOperation
	source-comment   [5] CharacterString OPTIONAL
	target-comment   [6] CharacterString OPTIONAL
	invoke-id        [7] Unsigned8 OPTIONAL
	source-user-id   [8] Unsigned16 OPTIONAL
	source-user-role [9] Unsigned8 OPTIONAL
	target-device    [10] BACnetRecipient
	target-object    [11] BACnetObjectIdentifier OPTIONAL
	target-property  [12] BACnetPropertyReference OPTIONAL
	target-priority  [13] Unsigned (1..16) OPTIONAL
	target-value     [14] ABSTRACT-SYNTAX.&Type OPTIONAL
	current-value    [15] ABSTRACT-SYNTAX.&Type OPTIONAL
	result           [16] Error OPTIONAL

The layout is the one bacnet-stack 1.6 (bacaudit.c) and BACpypes3 (basetypes.AuditNotification) encode and decode; the interop suite checks both directions against them.

### type SubscribeCOVPropertyMultipleRequest

```go
type SubscribeCOVPropertyMultipleRequest struct {
	SubscriberProcessIdentifier uint32
	// Cancellation omits issue-confirmed-notifications and lifetime, which
	// asks the device to cancel the subscription. IssueConfirmedNotifications
	// and LifetimeRemaining are then ignored.
	Cancellation                bool
	IssueConfirmedNotifications bool
	LifetimeRemaining           *uint32 // seconds; nil = absent
	MaxNotificationDelay        *uint32 // seconds; nil = absent
	Subscriptions               []COVMultipleSubscription
}
```

SubscribeCOVPropertyMultipleRequest is a SubscribeCOVPropertyMultiple request:

	subscriber-process-identifier [0] Unsigned32
	issue-confirmed-notifications [1] BOOLEAN OPTIONAL
	lifetime                      [2] Unsigned OPTIONAL
	max-notification-delay        [3] Unsigned OPTIONAL
	list-of-cov-subscription-specifications [4] SEQUENCE OF SEQUENCE {
	  monitored-object-identifier [0] BACnetObjectIdentifier
	  list-of-cov-references      [1] SEQUENCE OF SEQUENCE {
	    monitored-property [0] BACnetPropertyReference
	    cov-increment      [1] REAL OPTIONAL
	    timestamped        [2] BOOLEAN } }

A request without issue-confirmed-notifications and without lifetime cancels the subscription; with only one of the two it is inconsistent and a device refuses it.

The layout is checked against Wireshark's dissector (make dissector) and against the request parsers of BACnet4J and BACpypes3 (INTEROP.md).

#### func DecodeSubscribeCOVPropertyMultiple

```go
func DecodeSubscribeCOVPropertyMultiple(payload []byte, limits bacnet.DecodeLimits) (SubscribeCOVPropertyMultipleRequest, error)
```

DecodeSubscribeCOVPropertyMultiple decodes SubscribeCOVPropertyMultiple. The non-standard layout this library emitted up to v0.3.0 (subscription list at context \[3]) is rejected as malformed.

### type YouAre

```go
type YouAre struct {
	VendorID     uint16
	ModelName    string
	SerialNumber string
	// Device is the optional device-identifier. The zero value means absent:

	MAC []byte
}
```

Wire form matches ASHRAE 135 You-Are-Request SEQUENCE without context tags: application Unsigned16 + CharacterString + CharacterString, then the optional device-identifier ObjectIdentifier and the optional device-mac-address OctetString.
